text:
alex: quick ping — PR #2411 updates gofmt/gofumpt run for backend packages. CI shows import reorder on mac-builder. Need 2 approvals for merge window at 5pm PT. @maria @sophie can one of you eyeball?

maria: on it, ping me again in 10 if I don't reply

sophie: I'll take a look now. Which branch? link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2411

ci-bot: CI / unit-tests (mac-builder) failed — gofmt check failed in pkg/backend/connector.go (diff shown). See: https://ci.redwood/inference/2411/checks/5

alex: small repro: `gofumpt -w pkg/backend && git add -A && git commit -m "apply gofumpt"` — I tried that locally, got a reordering change. I pushed a fixup branch `pr-2411-fmt-fix` with the applied gofumpt.

sophie: I see the diff — imports reordered but it's gofumpt-only. Suggest we run gofumpt at tip of tree then amend commit:
```bash
gofumpt -w pkg/backend
git add pkg/backend/connector.go
git commit --amend --no-edit
git push -f origin pr-2411
```

maria: @sophie quick Q: does this change any public signatures?

sophie: no, just formatting and a small comment rewrap. I left a one-line rename in test to satisfy linter (s/resp/response/) — it's safe.

alex: CI rerun queued. @tj can you give second approval after green? timing: aim to merge after 5pm PT to avoid disrupting morning deploys.

tj: Will watch. If green, I'll +2 and merge. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI / unit-tests (mac-builder) succeeded — all checks passed. Link: https://ci.redwood/inference/2411/checks/6

tj: +2 — merging now. note: used squash, kept original commit message.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll monitor error budget.

sophie: :party_parrot: nice, let us know if anything flakey appears.
